applications.joinIntro: When enabled, new members must complete your form and wait for approval before they can join (Explore joins and normal invite links). Create a {directInvite} from the invite panel to share a link that skips this step.
applications.optionsHint: Up to {max} options; labels must be unique (ignoring case).
applications.maxFileHint: Leave blank to use the uploader’s plan limit (at most {max} MiB). Lower values help keep applications lightweight.

err.label: Each question needs a label.
err.noOptions: Choice questions need at least one non-empty option.
err.tooMany: Too many options on one question.

applications.noPermission: You don’t have permission to manage applications for this server.
applications.enableDesc: Gate joins behind your questionnaire and waitlist.
applications.formBuilderDesc: Build your questionnaire: joiners see questions in order. Choice questions use explicit options; file uploads use your storage plan limits unless you set a lower cap.
applications.noQuestions: No questions yet. Add at least one to collect meaningful responses.
applications.waitlistDesc: Pending applications. Approve to add the member; reject to dismiss.

discord.bridgeIntro: Mirror messages between this Echo channel and Discord. Inbound requires the Echo export bot online with {perm} + Message Content. Outbound uses a Discord incoming webhook (paste the URL from Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks). Webhook messages show a custom name and avatar per Echo user — they are not real Discord accounts.
discord.step3Desc: Build the Discord user -> Echo user map from {file} and restore each member's roles so linked accounts keep them after merge.
discord.resumeDesc: Import picks up from the next incomplete step. Current next step:
discord.membersUserMapDesc: Discord -> Echo user ids and per-member roles.
discord.needPermBridge: You need permission to manage this server to configure the bridge.
discord.noTextChannels: No text channels in this server.
discord.webhookStored: A webhook is already stored; leave blank to keep it, or paste a new URL to replace.
discord.needPermImport: You need permission to manage this server to run Discord import.
discord.refreshDesc: After the export bot writes a new bundle to the server folder, run this to re-apply branding and the imported emoji pack, then rebuild categories and channels from the export. Use it to fix a bad import, pick up new channels, or sync layout changes. All messages in guild channels are removed when channels are replaced.
discord.sourceDesc: The import reads from the fixed MTI export configured on the backend.
discord.importMetadataDesc: Pull the server name, description, icon, and banner from the Discord export.
discord.importRolesDesc: Translate Discord roles into Echo roles and restore hierarchy ordering.
discord.importChannelsDesc: Create categories, channels, and translated overwrite rows from the export.
discord.rolesDesc: Translated Echo roles and role order.
discord.channelsDesc: Categories, channels, and role overwrite rows.
discord.retryHint: Fix the problem, then retry the failed step. Details above are also saved on the import state for this server.
